description: This file defines a helper class `BankingServiceHelper` providing methods to convert between domain models and entity models for a banking application. It includes conversion methods for customer, account, address, contact, bank information, transaction, and transfer details, facilitating data transformation within the service layer.

classes.name: BankingServiceHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing conversion methods between domain models and entity models related to banking operations.

methods.name: convertToCustomerDomain
methods.description: Converts a Customer entity to CustomerDetails domain model.

methods.name: convertToCustomerEntity
methods.description: Converts CustomerDetails domain model to Customer entity.

methods.name: convertToAccountDomain
methods.description: Converts an Account entity to AccountInformation domain model.

methods.name: convertToAccountEntity
methods.description: Converts AccountInformation domain model to Account entity.

methods.name: convertToAddressDomain
methods.description: Converts Address entity to AddressDetails domain model.

methods.name: convertToAddressEntity
methods.description: Converts AddressDetails domain model to Address entity.

methods.name: convertToContactDomain
methods.description: Converts Contact entity to ContactDetails domain model.

methods.name: convertToContactEntity
methods.description: Converts ContactDetails domain model to Contact entity.

methods.name: convertToBankInfoDomain
methods.description: Converts BankInfo model to BankInformation domain model.

methods.name: convertToBankInfoEntity
methods.description: Converts BankInformation domain model to BankInfo entity.

methods.name: convertToTransactionDomain
methods.description: Converts a Transaction entity to TransactionDetails domain model.

methods.name: convertToTransactionEntity
methods.description: Converts TransactionDetails domain model to Transaction entity.

methods.name: createTransaction
methods.description: Creates a Transaction object based on transfer details, account number, and transaction type.
